zcc/public-api-controller/update-the-pro.operation_summary: Update the properties of the application profile using profile ID

request_body.name: active
request_body.description: Indicates whether the policy is active.

request_body.name: appServiceIds
request_body.description: IDs of the application services associated with the policy.

request_body.name: bypassAppIds
request_body.description: The IDs of the applications configured to bypass policy enforcement.

request_body.name: bypassCustomAppIds
request_body.description: The IDs of the custom applications configured to bypass policy enforcement.

request_body.name: description
request_body.description: The description of the application profile.

request_body.name: deviceGroupIds
request_body.description: The ID of the device group.

request_body.name: deviceType
request_body.description: The type of device.

request_body.name: enableDeviceGroups
request_body.description: Indicates whether device groups are enabled.

request_body.name: groupAll
request_body.description: Specifies if the rule applies to all device groups.

request_body.name: groupIds
request_body.description: Specifies the device group IDs to which the rule applies.

request_body.name: highlightActiveControl
request_body.description: Indicates whether an outline around an actively selected control is displayed.

request_body.name: id
request_body.description: ID of the profile.

request_body.name: logFileSize
request_body.description: Specifies the maximum size of the log file.

request_body.name: logLevel
request_body.description: Specifies log severity (Low 0, Normal 1, and High 2)

request_body.name: logMode
request_body.description: Specifies the scope of the logs.

request_body.name: name
request_body.description: Specifies the name of the application profile.

request_body.name: pac_url
request_body.description: The PAC URL.

request_body.name: policyToken
request_body.description: Specifies the token key required to download policy for Zscaler Client Connector.

request_body.name: reactivateWebSecurityMinutes
request_body.description: Specifies the time, in minutes, for Zscaler Client Connector to reactivate internet security if the user turns it off.

request_body.name: reauth_period
request_body.description: The automatic ZPA reauthentication time (in seconds).

request_body.name: ruleOrder
request_body.description: The order of the app profile rule. The rule order reflects the order of precedence among configured profile policy rules and helps determine which rule the app downloads for a user upon enrollment. Precedence is based on ascending numerical order.

request_body.name: sendDisableServiceReason
request_body.description: Description about why a Zscaler service (e.g., ZIA, ZPA, ZDX) was disabled on a device.

request_body.name: tunnelZappTraffic
request_body.description: Indicates whether Tunnel Zapp Traffic is enabled. When enabled, Zscaler Client Connector tunnels internal traffic through Zscaler, and continues to send PAC requests directly.

request_body.name: userIds
request_body.description: Specifies the list of user IDs to whom the policy is assigned.

request_body.name: hostname
request_body.description: The hostname of the network.

request_body.name: id
request_body.description: ID of the forwarding profile.

request_body.name: name
request_body.description: Specifies the name of the forwarding profile.

request_body.name: resolvedIpsForHostname
request_body.description: The IP addresses that the hostname resolves to.

request_body.name: skipTrustedCriteriaMatch
request_body.description: Indicates if Skip Trusted Criteria match for VPN Adapters is enabled.

request_body.name: trustedDhcpServers
request_body.description: The DHCP server of the trusted network.

request_body.name: trustedEgressIps
request_body.description: The egress IP address of the network.

request_body.name: trustedGateways
request_body.description: The IP address of the default gateway.

request_body.name: trustedNetworkIds
request_body.description: The IDs of trusted networks.

request_body.name: trustedSubnets
request_body.description: The subnet of the trusted network.
